notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
A few fixes in the first patch:

- Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow speedrun score to be uploaded to Steam leaderboards on first completion.
- Squid Warden boss now teleports you to one of four corners instead of randomly
- Fixed a bug where player would get trapped underneath Restless Guardians boss if it spawned on top of them
- Miniature O.B.E. sphere enemies pause for one second when player enters the room

Sorry if you completed a speedrun and didn't get on the leaderboards before now! You'll either have to beat your previous speedrun's time or delete the settings.ini in the local game files to upload again.
